title: Emergency Dispatch Charge on a Calloway Limited Home Warranty Coverage
content:
## What the charge is

Under the Calloway Limited Home Warranty a technician is dispatched to an item reported as an emergency. When the dispatch finds no covered defect, the dispatch may carry an emergency dispatch charge to the homeowner. The charge is worked out on the day it is assessed and is linked to the claim item the technician was dispatched to. Once booked, it appears with its own charge number on the homeowner's warranty invoice and in the coverage's charge history, and its amount is added to the warranty charges the homeowner owes on that coverage.

The dispatch charge is fixed only after every re-reported item that a re-measurement again found within tolerance and that the reinspection rules make chargeable carries its reinspection charge.

## Booking the charge

Tool: `assess_emergency_dispatch_charge_91903470`, an agent-side tool. The desk agent unlocks it and then calls it. One call books one emergency dispatch charge, dated the day of the call, for a technician dispatch to an emergency item that was not a covered defect.

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `coverage_id` | The reference number of the homeowner's warranty coverage on the home, as returned by the warranty coverage lookup for this homeowner | Identifier, as returned by the lookup |
| `claim_item_ref` | The service request item number of the emergency item the technician was dispatched to | Copied character for character, digits and hyphens included, exactly as shown in the coverage's warranty history, with no reformatting |
| `amount` | The charge amount in US dollars | A positive number with 2 decimal places, already rounded to the nearest cent; no currency sign or thousands separator |

## What the call returns

A receipt whose `status` is `charge_booked` means the charge is on the coverage. It also carries `warranty_event_id` (reference number of the new charge entry), `charge_reference` (the charge number printed on the homeowner invoice, text such as WCH-51234), `coverage_id` (the coverage charged), `claim_item_ref` (the item the charge is linked to), `charge_type` (always `emergency_dispatch_fee`), `amount` (US dollars, 2 decimal places), `event_date` (the assessment date, YYYY-MM-DD) and `charges_due` (the homeowner's warranty charges owed on the coverage including this charge, US dollars, 2 decimal places).
